supports.question: Is the paper visibly stuffed inside the cup, rather than merely resting nearby or on its rim?
supports.criteria: Pass if the image shows the paper placed inside the cup with visible evidence it has been stuffed into it. Fail if the paper is visibly outside the cup or only resting nearby or on its rim. Unknown if the image does not provide enough evidence to distinguish these cases.
supports.binding: The paper must be stuffed into the cup; merely being nearby or on the rim does not satisfy the requested outcome.

supports.question: Is there visible evidence that the paper has been moved toward or into the cup, even if it is not yet stuffed inside?
supports.criteria: Pass if visible evidence shows progress toward placing the paper into the cup, but the paper is not visibly stuffed inside it. Fail if there is no visible progress toward the requested placement, or if the paper is visibly stuffed inside the cup. Unknown if the image does not provide enough evidence to determine progress.
supports.binding: Progress counts only when it advances the requested act of stuffing the paper into the cup; unrelated edits do not count.

parsed.fulfillment_criteria: Return yes when support 1 passes: the requested outcome is visibly complete. A skipped support is unobserved, not automatically inapplicable; on any skipped path, return a decision only if the remaining evidence establishes that same outcome under the rubric, otherwise return unknown.
